To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the obtained spiro-thiazine derivatives are biologically active compounds that are capable of blocking the calcium ion uptake into rat brain cortex synaptosomes.

we have synthesized a series of novel spiro-compounds with thiazine ring as the lead-compounds for potential neuroprotectors, determined the biological activity of the compounds and their distribution coefficients in octanol/buffe and hexane/buffe systems, and made a correlation of the inhibitory activity with the lipophilicity data and with the descriptors characterizing donor-acceptor propertis of the compounds.
we have synthesized and tested a new class of compounds with potential neuroprotective activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and study of the physico-chemical and biological properties of the new class of neuroprotectors, spiro-thiazine derivatives, which are promising as drugs to treat neurodegenerative disorders.
the development of a new class of neuroprotectors with the spiro-thiazine structure.
the development of a new group of spiro-thazine derivatives as potential neuroprotectors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the investigated spiro-1,3-thia-zines are potential neuroprotectors with a high ability to penetrate the biological membrane.
the spiro-thiazine derivatives with alkyl radicals in ortho- or para-positions in the aril ring of the molecules are the most active substances and have high membrane permeability.
the spiro-thiazine derivatives with ortho- and/or para-substituents in the aril fragment of the molecule are the lead-compound with high inhibitory activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the spiro-thiazine structure is promising for the design of new neuroprotective agents.
the obtained results can be used in the development of the new neuroprotective agents.
the synthesized compounds can be considered as potential neuroprotectors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the obtained compounds can be used as the lead-compounds for developing the new neuroprotectors.
the obtained compounds can be used for the development of new drugs with neuroprotective properties. 1
the spiro-thiazine derivatives can be used as neuroprotectors.
